title: KEYTU
description: Technical mountaineering apparel told as an ascent of K2. Pinned altitude meter and tritone photography.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · GSAP ScrollTrigger · Lenis

sections.title: Top bar
sections.summary: (fixed, 68px, solid black): logo, section links, outline "Expedition list" button.

sections.title: Hero
sections.summary: (100svh): K2 photo under a black gradient. Bottom-left: mono kicker, display h1 "Built above the treeline.", lead paragraph, buttons "Begin the ascent" (solid white) and "Expedition lookbook" (outline).

sections.title: The ascent
sections.summary: - **Desktop:** two columns. The left is a `position: sticky` stage (100svh under the bar). The right holds 7 chapters, each at least 100svh.

customCodeBlocks.title: KEYTU Scoped Styles
customCodeBlocks.description: Authored custom CSS variables, pseudo-elements, and keyframe rules that supplement native Webflow styles.

customCodeBlocks.title: KEYTU Interactive Runtime Bridge
